LightningComponentBundle.description: Compares a bound measure with a threshold and turns red when breached; optional one-click filter to focus the dashboard on a dimension value.

property.name: measureField
property.label: Measure
property.description: Measure to compare with the threshold.

property.name: belowIsBad
property.label: Below threshold is bad
property.description: Off: values above the threshold trigger the alert. On: values below do.

property.name: focusDimension
property.label: Focus Dimension
property.description: Optional dimension for the one-click focus filter.

property.name: focusValue
property.label: Focus Value
property.description: Value of the focus dimension to filter to (e.g. Renters).
